test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow's from the given statements.

Statements:

All boxes are glasses.

All glasses are cups.

Some cups are bottles.

Conclusions:

(I): All boxes are cups.

(II): Some glasses are bottles.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/159a05701ae15cbe3c37e66554f49745d633d54c5d58cebf309b3ad0eabfe1a7.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I): All boxes are cups → **True **(As, All boxes are glasses, All glasses are cups. so, All boxes are cups holds true)

(II): Some glasses are bottles → False ( There is no direct relation between them.)

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
